line: Give a little to a cause you care about.
paragraph: Two teenagers in South Florida spent two years building an app with the skills they had sharpened through volunteering. The app lets anyone buy a pizza from a local restaurant and send it straight to a nearby charity. A person picks a restaurant, picks a charity, and a fresh pizza travels from one to the other. No one has to wonder if the food arrived or if the help felt like help. The teens made the whole path visible and simple. Someone hungry gets a hot meal. Someone generous gets a clear way to give.

seed.summary: Two South Florida teens with a penchant for volunteering have used their IT skills to build an app that facilitates the donation of pizzas from local restaurants to local charities. It streamlines the donation process, allowing anyone to send fresh pizzas from any nearby restaurant to any nearby charity of their choice. Designed 2 years
seed.sourceTitle: Florida Teens Design Charity App to Help Generous Locals Deliver ‘Pizza for a Purpose’
